formula: Exact Recall@20 = number of true causal SNPs in the saved 20-SNP selected set / 20 true causal SNPs.
truth_index_conversion: Raw causal_effects.csv snp_index is one based; subtract one to match screened_indices.npy. Converted truth matches saved oracle indices in all 300 runs.
boxplot: Box = 25th-75th percentiles; horizontal line = median; whiskers extend to the most extreme actual values within 1.5 IQR. Every repeat is shown, including values beyond the whiskers.
points: One dot per independent repeat. Identical recall values are spread horizontally in repeat-number order; no vertical jitter.
